visualCharacteristics.purpose: Standalone call-to-action button group using the site CTA styles
visualCharacteristics.layout: Stacked CTA buttons with 16px gap; width and style from option classes

contentPattern.structure: one or more CTA paragraphs (strong link primary, em link secondary, strong+em link tertiary)

usage: Button rows between content sections on landing and program pages
reuseGuidance: Reuse cta for new pages with the same content pattern; add an option class rather than a new block for colour or layout differences.
